payload.reason: The evidence provides clear information about the use of question generation models in the context of machine reading comprehension and knowledge-based reasoning.

claims.text: A question generation model is used to generate questions based on the semantics of a candidate answer in machine reading comprehension tasks.
The question generation model is part of a framework that includes both question answering and question generation models, leveraging knowledge from external knowledge bases.
The model improves the accuracy of question answering systems by incorporating additional evidence from external knowledge bases.
